Index.title: Mekteb
Index.heroTitle: Run your mekteb without the paper register
Index.heroSubtitle: Attendance, hifz, homework and parent messages for mosque schools. Teachers use it in class on their phone, parents see what happened the same day.
Index.featuresSubtitle: The rest of the week: lessons, exams, groups and the calendar.
Index.feature_students_desc: Enroll students, organize profiles, and keep track of all your learners in one centralized system.
Index.feature_attendance_desc: Record and monitor attendance for every session. Know who was present, absent, late, or excused.
Index.feature_lessons_desc: Build a structured library of lessons and topics. Organize your curriculum with ease.
Index.feature_homework_desc: Create and publish homework for groups or individual students with due dates and instructions.
Index.feature_parents_desc: Keep parents connected with accounts, progress notes, and visibility into their child's education.
Index.feature_groups_desc: Create groups, assign teachers, enroll students, and manage your Mekteb's structure effortlessly.
Index.githubSubtitle: Mekteb is open source. Inspect the code, report issues, or contribute on GitHub.
Index.ctaTitle: Set it up before your next class
Index.ctaSubtitle: Creating a mosque takes a few minutes. Or open the demo first and click through it with sample data.
Index.tryDemoDesc: Explore the dashboard with sample data. No sign-up required.
Index.howSubtitle: From setup to first attendance in under 10 minutes.
Index.step_1_desc: Create an account, configure your mosque profile, upload branding.
Index.step_2_desc: Onboard teachers and parents in one click. Temporary passwords generated automatically.
Index.step_3_desc: Record attendance, send homework, message families — parents see updates in real time.
Index.rolesSubtitle: Each role sees only what they need to. Our system ensures everyone has a tailored and secure experience.
Index.platformsTitle: Web app and native iOS app
Index.platformsSubtitle: Manage in the browser at your desk; parents and teachers use the iOS app on the go. Push notifications included.
Index.platforms_b_1: Web app in all modern browsers
Index.platforms_b_2: Native iOS app with push notifications
Index.pricingTitle: Priced by how many students you teach
Index.pricingSubtitle: Free during the beta. No credit card, no trial that runs out.
Index.pricingCommunityF5: Built for communities managing multiple mosques
Index.pricingSelfHostDesc: Mekteb is open source. Run it on your own infrastructure for free.
Index.faq_1_a: All your data is securely stored in the EU, ensuring full privacy and compliance. We use industry-leading security to keep your community's information safe.
Index.faq_2_a: During the beta Mekteb is free for every mosque. Plans for associations with several locations will follow after the beta.
Index.faq_3_a: Yes. You own your data and can request an export at any time.
Index.faq_4_a: Yes. Mekteb is built to scale and can easily manage multiple locations or branches under one organization.
Index.feature_exams_desc: Run oral and written exams, track results, and generate diplomas — the whole assessment loop in one place.
Index.feature_quran_desc: A structured Quran curriculum with memorisation tracking, so hifz progress is visible to teachers, parents, and students.
Index.feature_messaging_desc: Private 1-to-1 chat between teachers, parents, and admins — no phone numbers exchanged, everything stays in the app.
Index.feature_calendar_desc: Sessions, events, and prayer times on one calendar, with a weekly timetable per group and reminders that reach the right people.
Index.feature_announcements_desc: Publish mosque-wide or group-specific announcements that land in every portal and in push notifications.
Index.feature_audio_desc: Attach recordings of the lesson text — in every language you teach — so students can listen instead of read.
Index.gallerySubtitle: The key views of the platform — for every role, with sample data.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1_body: This Privacy Policy applies to the Mekteb platform operated by the mosque that registered you for this platform. The Mosque acts as data controller under GDPR.
Privacy.s2_body: We collect and process the following personal data:
Privacy.s2_item1: Name, email address and password (encrypted) of registered users
Privacy.s2_item3: Homework assignments, progress notes and educational content
Privacy.s2_item4: Messages and announcements within the platform
Privacy.s3_body: We process data of minors solely in the context of the Mosque's educational activities. Student and parent accounts are created only by Mosque administrators. Parents have the right to access, correct and request deletion of their children's data.
Privacy.s4_body: Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract performance) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interests) for secure platform operation.
Privacy.s5_body: You have the following rights regarding your stored data:
Privacy.s5_item1: Right to access, rectification and erasure
Privacy.s5_item2: Right to restriction of processing and data portability
Privacy.s5_item3: Right to object and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority
Privacy.s6_body: We do not share your data with third parties unless required to provide the service (e.g. hosting provider Supabase) or required by law. Our processors are contractually bound to comply with GDPR.
Privacy.s7_body: Passwords are stored encrypted. All connections use HTTPS.
Privacy.s8_body: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected or as required by law.
Privacy.s9_body: For privacy-related questions, please contact your Mosque administration.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.s1_body: These Terms of Service govern the use of the Mekteb platform by Mosque members (administrators, teachers, parents and students).
Terms.s2_body: Accounts are created exclusively by Mosque administrators. You are required to keep your credentials confidential.
Terms.s3_body: The platform may only be used for educational and communication purposes in the context of Mekteb operations.
Terms.s4_body: The following activities are expressly prohibited:
Terms.s4_item1: Sharing inappropriate, offensive or unlawful content
Terms.s4_item2: Unauthorised access to other users' accounts
Terms.s4_item3: Misuse of communication features for advertising or spam
Terms.s5_body: You are solely responsible for content you post on the platform.
Terms.s6_body: The platform is provided without express or implied warranties. The Mosque is not liable for damages arising from use or unavailability of the platform.
Terms.s7_body: These Terms may be modified at any time. Material changes will be announced on the platform.
